meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 做出一份可点击、能分支跳转、带演讲备注的演示幻灯片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要把想法或网页做成能上台演示的交互幻灯片。
copy.tagline_en: Build a clickable presentation deck with branching and speaker notes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn ideas or a webpage into an interactive deck to present.

howto.what: 做出可放映的幻灯片 deck:离散幻灯片、分段揭示、热点分支跳转、带演讲备注的演讲者模式,还能把已有网页转成 deck。产出是可导航的 deck,不是渲染好的 MP4。
howto.when: 当你明确要求做幻灯片、pitch deck、交互式 deck,或把已有网页转成 deck 时;若只是相邻说法(如「presentation」),会先问「要做成 HyperFrames slideshow 吗」再动手。

say.text: 把这个页面转成幻灯片 deck,保留原来的视觉和交互。
say.note: 转换前会先确认,再按源页面保真移植。

say.text: 给这个 deck 的第 2 张幻灯片加演讲备注和热点分支。
say.note: 备注和热点写入 deck 的 JSON island。

say.text: 用 hyperframes present 放映这个 deck。
say.note: 输出是实时放映的 deck,不是 MP4。

howto.what_en: Builds a runnable slideshow deck: discrete slides, fragment reveals, hotspot branching, presenter mode with speaker notes; it also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask for a slideshow, pitch deck, or interactive deck, or to convert a page into a deck. Adjacent wording prompts a confirmation question first.

say_en.text: Turn this page into a slideshow deck, keeping its visuals and interactions.
say_en.note: Confirms first, then ports with source fidelity.

say_en.text: Add speaker notes and a hotspot branch to slide 2 of this deck.
say_en.note: Writes notes and hotspots into the JSON island.

say_en.text: Present this deck with hyperframes present.
say_en.note: Runs the live deck; no render.
